spectral_reference: An independent full-rank, nondegenerate family source B in the physical GJ basis. Match B to the R1712 down matrix at the test point. The real alignment energy uses -B^dagger p'_H(H), H=BB^dagger. Its Wilson coefficient, potential, field implementing the link and independent spurion origin are additional model choices.
splitting_convention: Two bare signs of the same nonsupersymmetric vectorlike Dirac triplet mass have magnitudes M(1+delta) and M(1-delta), previously identical endpoint couplings. Compare fully normalized tree down Yukawa at zero electroweak vev. No other color thresholds are moved.
physical_scope: Finite tree-level SM-gauge-covariant matching with a family-only unitary link, two equal and opposite mass paths for the physical lightest up eigenline, and full-rank reciprocal output. Additional colored multiplets change the running above matching.
